checks.detail: schemaVersion='human-infra.life-path-toy-results.v1'
source path and sha256 must point back to the scenario input
required=['evidenceBoundary', 'modelClass', 'modelName', 'nonUses', 'purpose', 'upgradeGate']
model card must explicitly prohibit death-date or individual prediction use
model card must state the synthetic evidence boundary
scenario_count=4
ids=['baseline', 'assisted', 'convergence', 'escape']
baseline scenario must be present for comparison
each scenario must expose required metrics
scenario survival curves must be monotonic non-increasing
survival and health-quality values must remain in [0, 1]
resource budget percentages must remain in [0, 100]
LEV >= 1 must be reported as open boundary
prohibited_keys=[]
schemaVersion='human-infra.life-path-calibration-readiness.v1'
readiness contract must explicitly say real cohort, calibration, external validation, and individual use are unavailable
missing_standards=[]
missing_sections=[]
target population must define minimum real-cohort fields and current placeholder
time zero must define index-date rule fields before calibration
outcomes must include primary cohort outcomes and forbid individual death-date output
estimands must define scenario-level questions before calibration
data requirements must state that real cohort and endpoint follow-up are missing
validation plan must include internal/external validation fields and not-started status
calibration plan must include diagnostics and not-started status
sensitivity analysis plan must define required analyses
bias and applicability plan must define risk domains
reporting plan must define required artifacts beyond Web visualization
prohibited uses must block individual death-date prediction and medical advice
upgrade gate must keep the current decision at cannot-calibrate-yet

standardAlignment.localGate: model card + schema + transparent scenario output + calibration readiness fields
standardAlignment.boundary: toy model only; no development, calibration, or validation cohort
formal risk-of-bias assessment requires real study design and data

standardAlignment.localGate: versioned inputs, executable model, generated outputs, audit artifact, planned sensitivity fields
standardAlignment.boundary: no decision model, calibration, cost model, or executed sensitivity analysis yet

standardAlignment.localGate: mechanism chain and context boundary in maturity roadmap
standardAlignment.boundary: stakeholder process and implementation evaluation are not started

standardAlignment.localGate: target population, time zero, outcome, predictor, time-at-risk and validation placeholders
standardAlignment.boundary: no OHDSI dataset, package execution, or patient-level prediction study is claimed
